verdict.rationale: Gusto ships a first-party, actively-released public CLI (gusto-cli) explicitly designed for agentic workflows: dual human/agent JSON output, --dry-run and --confirm human-in-the-loop gates, a dedicated AGENTS.md, bundled agent skills auto-installed into Claude/Cursor/Windsurf/Cline workspaces, headless CI auth via env vars or stdin token, and a verifiable install script hosted on Gusto's own cli.gusto.com domain with SHA256-verified releases. This is corroborated across the GitHub repo, raw AGENTS.md fetch, install script probe, and release API, going well beyond a bare CLI to explicit AI-native tooling. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on usage reports (only vendor/GitHub-sourced evidence) and the official product page is blocked by Cloudflare to crawlers.
